name: FACTORY CONSTITUTION - the fixed things of every film (from our accepted film v5). The factory applies them; the brain never re-decides them.
principle: Everything that needs thinking is decided by the brain (third model) in the order. Everything mechanical (exact positions, timing, camera maths, styling, rhythm, sound mapping, quality checks) is done by the factory with these rules.

look.other_country_tint_rule: same family: saturation 35-55 %, lightness 40-60 %, neighbours clearly different in hue; the same country keeps the same tint in every film

fills.inner_glow: 16 px fill colour at 60 % + 3.2 px white at 32 %, clipped inside

borders.trace: draw-on with a soft glow head

fonts.head: Cinzel (titles, story country names 600-700, years, title cards)
fonts.body: Inter (kickers, sub-lines, flag labels 600-700, spacing 0.05-0.08 em)
fonts.serif: Cormorant Garamond (italic: neighbour names, places, quotes, document bodies)
fonts.script: Great Vibes (signatures, handwritten titles in documents only)

look.light: warm from the upper left, shadows down-right, soft, never pure black

elements.flag: flag-icons 4x3 on a short pole, spring drop, soft shadow, true ratio via FLAG_ASPECT, lands on the country's label anchor (placed with tools/place.ts)
elements.banner: wooden pole + gold finial, cloth unfurl with an archival photo, parchment caption plate 224 px, ground shadow, optional depth near-layer
elements.date_card: top-left (pos tl), Cinzel date + Inter sub-line
elements.chapter_card: CHAPTER <n> + title, Cinzel with gold rules, full-frame dim
elements.title_card: Cinzel ivory lines + gold rule, smoky reveal
elements.icon3d: Blender render at 4 azimuths, smoothstep lift, shadow follows, visible object 236 px
elements.document: Manim parchment, full frame, hand-written reveal, map dimmed
elements.numeral: big Cinzel gold number + Inter sub-line
elements.credits: end card with the archival credits (auto from archive/credits.json)

sound.voice: platform voice made in the chat, one take per paragraph, matched by voice_master.py

quality_gate: every paragraph has its platform take

3d.big_moments: Blender templates on Kaggle GPU (each film changes the object, the place and the choreography)
3d.small_icons: TripoSR on Kaggle + Blender renders, only for small icons

kaggle_key: never stored in GitHub: the brain injects KAGGLE_API_TOKEN + KAGGLE_USERNAME as temporary repo secrets, dispatches, withdraws them as soon as the Kaggle job has started, and checks the secret list is empty
